routes.name: Visa-free short stay (Schengen)
routes.summary: Croatia is in Schengen. Citizens of visa-exempt countries can stay up to 90 days in any 180-day period. Check the official list to see if your passport is on it.

other: Which nationalities are visa-exempt is on the MVEP list, which I could not read. Confirm there.

sources.label: MUP: Do you need a visa?
MVEP: Visa system overview

stay.note: Days in any Schengen country count.

routes.name: Short-stay Schengen visa (type C)
routes.summary: For nationals who need a visa. Up to 90 days in any 180 days. Apply no earlier than 6 months and no later than 15 days before the trip. Travel medical insurance is required.

other: Fee amount not read from an official page.

sources.label: MUP: Do you need a visa?

documents: Travel medical insurance valid across Schengen for the whole stay

routes.name: Airport transit visa (type A)
routes.summary: A visa for passing through the international transit area of an airport, for nationals who need one. Check the official list for which nationalities.

other: Nationalities requiring an airport transit visa not confirmed.

sources.label: MUP: Do you need a visa?

stay.note: Stay inside the airport transit area only.

routes.name: Long-stay visa (type D)
routes.summary: A national visa for people who need a visa and were granted temporary stay. Apply at a Croatian mission once the permit is approved.

other: Page wording on the D visa is vague (mentions up to 30 days). The digital nomad page says a D visa fee of EUR 93.00 at a consulate. Confirm details.

sources.label: MUP: Do you need a visa?
MUP: Digital nomad stay

fees.label: D visa at consulate (digital nomad page)

routes.name: Temporary stay of digital nomads
routes.summary: Work remotely for a foreign employer or your own company registered outside Croatia. Up to 18 months. You can't work for Croatian clients. You can't renew straight away: reapply 6 months after it ends.

income.note: 2.5 average monthly net salaries, plus 10% per extra family member

savings.note: Alternative proof for 18 months. EUR 43,470 for 12 months.

other: Employer or company must not be registered in Croatia
Health insurance for the full stay
Criminal record certificate
Passport valid 3 months beyond the stay

sources.label: MUP: Temporary stay of digital nomads

stay.note: Extension up to 6 months if first permit was under 18 months. New permit possible 6 months after expiry.

steps: Apply online through the ministry's digital nomad portal, or at an embassy or consulate
Visa-required nationals must apply at a Croatian mission
After approval, get a D visa if needed
Register your address within 3 days of entry
Pick up the biometric residence card at the police station

routes.name: Temporary stay (general)
routes.summary: Base permit for most long stays. Granted up to one year for purposes like study, research, family, humanitarian reasons, work or other purposes. You must prove your purpose, have funds and health insurance.

other: Valid travel document
Funds to support yourself (no amount published on the page)
Health insurance
Clean criminal record on first application
Not a threat to public order or security

sources.label: MUP: Temporary stay of third-country nationals

stay.note: Permit can be withdrawn after long absences.

routes.name: Temporary stay for study
routes.summary: Temporary stay for secondary school or university studies, under the general temporary stay rules. Full-time students may work up to 20 hours a week without a separate work permit.

other: Enrollment proof and fund amounts not read from an official page.

sources.label: MUP: Temporary stay of third-country nationals
MUP: Work of third-country nationals

routes.name: Stay and work permit
routes.summary: One permit for stay and work with a named employer. The employer usually starts a labor market test and a Croatian Employment Service opinion. Some jobs and in-demand professions are exempt from the test.

other: Permit duration and quota rules not stated on the page.

sources.label: MUP: Work of third-country nationals

routes.name: Work registration certificate
routes.summary: For short contracted work: up to 90 days a year for some roles (scientists, correspondents, tourist agents) and up to 30 days for others (trainers, fair participants, consultants).

sources.label: MUP: Work of third-country nationals

stay.note: 30 days a year for some categories.

routes.name: Seasonal work permit
routes.summary: Seasonal jobs up to six months per year. Need a valid contract and proper accommodation from the employer.

other: Appropriate accommodation
Clean criminal record

sources.label: MUP: Seasonal workers

stay.note: Must leave after six months. Extendable once per six-month period.

routes.name: EU Blue Card (highly qualified workers)
routes.summary: For degree holders with a skilled job contract of at least one year with a Croatian employer. Salary minimum is not on the page.

other: Contract of at least one year
Salary threshold not stated on the official page

sources.label: MUP: Highly qualified third-country nationals

routes.name: Temporary stay for family reunification
routes.summary: For spouses, common-law partners, minor children and some parents of Croatian citizens or foreigners with permanent stay, temporary stay, long-term residence or protection. Sponsors on a one-year work permit must have held stay for one year first.

other: Income requirement, duration and fees not stated on the page.

sources.label: MUP: Family reunification

routes.name: Long-term residence
routes.summary: Apply after five years of legal stay. You need to pass a Croatian language and Latin script test unless exempt, and show funds to support yourself.

other: 5 years of legal stay
Absences under 10 months total, 6 months at once
Funds to support yourself (no amount published)

sources.label: MUP: Long-term residence and permanent stay

routes.name: Permanent stay (family of citizens and other groups)
routes.summary: Shorter route: 4 years of uninterrupted temporary stay for spouses or partners of Croatian citizens, 3 years for ethnic Croats with foreign citizenship, 3 years for minor children of permanent residents.

other: Categories vary, see official page
Absences under 6 months total, 4 months at once

sources.label: MUP: Long-term residence and permanent stay

routes.name: Naturalization and other citizenship routes
routes.summary: Apply through the police where you live. Descendants of emigrants and ethnic Croats have extra document rules. Years of residence, language test and dual citizenship rules weren't on the page I could read.

other: Residence years, language and test details not confirmed from an official page.
Application in person. Criminal record certificate under 6 months old.

citizenship.note: Croatian citizens can hold foreign citizenship per the termination section. Rules for people becoming citizens not confirmed.

other: Process details not read.

routes.summary: EU, EEA and Swiss citizens and their family members have free movement rights in Croatia. Details are on the ministry's EEA page.
